defaultValue.answer: We provide comprehensive analytical testing services including FESEM, XRD, FTIR, UV-Vis, TGA, DSC, and many more advanced characterization techniques for materials, pharmaceuticals, food, and chemical samples.
defaultValue.question: What types of analytical testing do you offer?

defaultValue.answer: Standard turnaround time is 5-7 business days. We also offer express services with 24-48 hour delivery for urgent projects. Timeline depends on the complexity of analysis and sample preparation requirements.
defaultValue.question: How long does it take to get test results?

defaultValue.answer: Yes, our expert team handles complete sample preparation including grinding, coating, mounting, and any pre-treatment required for accurate analysis. We ensure samples are optimally prepared for each testing method.
defaultValue.question: Do you provide sample preparation services?

defaultValue.answer: Absolutely. We provide detailed reports with expert interpretation, data analysis, and recommendations. Our scientists are available for consultation to discuss findings and their implications for your research or product development.
defaultValue.question: Can you help interpret the test results?

defaultValue.answer: We serve pharmaceuticals, materials science, food & agriculture, electronics, chemical industry, and academia. Our versatile testing capabilities support R&D, quality control, and regulatory compliance across diverse sectors.
defaultValue.question: What industries do you serve?

defaultValue.answer: Yes, we provide customized pricing packages for regular clients, academic institutions, and bulk testing requirements. Contact us to discuss volume discounts and partnership opportunities tailored to your needs.
defaultValue.question: Do you offer bulk or subscription pricing?
